description.value: Banditry Cider is an award-winning craft cidery on BC's Sunshine Coast, set on a farm property in Gibsons where 100% BC-grown apples are pressed without concentrates or artificial flavourings. The cidery has earned back-to-back Cidery of the Year recognition and multiple gold awards, and hosts regular community events including live music, jazz festivals, and open mic nights. Visiting cyclists will find outdoor seating in a relaxed orchard setting, a food truck (Banditry Cantina), and a dog- and family-friendly atmosphere complete with a playground and duck pond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms address, phone, and business identity matching OSM tags exactly. The FAQ page explicitly states 'Is your cider Gluten Free? Yes! Even our hopped ciders are gluten free,' and OSM carries diet:vegetarian=yes, supporting a true value for Vegetarian/vegan/GF. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; the OSM opening_hours tag (Th-Su 11:00-19:00) conflicts with the website (12pm–7pm), with the website treated as authoritative.
